name: Bayer CropScience Limited
summary: Bayer CropScience Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the agriculture business in India, Germany, Bangladesh, and internationally. The company manufactures, sells, and distributes agrochemical products, including insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, seed treatment solutions, and biologicals; produces, sells, and distributes hybrid corn seeds, as well as rice, fruits, and vegetables; and integrates digital farming solutions, such as remote sensing, artificial intelligence, IoT, drones, and data analytics.
